name: Dub With Your Friends
summary:
Dub With Your Friends is a free multiplayer party game played in the browser. Players pick a short scene from a film, series or cartoon, the original voices are removed while music and ambience stay, and everyone records the lines with their own voice in a private booth, without hearing the others. When the recordings are done, the group watches the "premiere" together and votes for the best dub.

Rooms hold from 1 to 10 players and can be public or private, with quick match available. There are seven game modes (Character, Parallel, Improv, Blind, Remix, Charades and Impostor) and eight voice effects. Scenes come in community packs, which players can make in the built-in Pack Creator. Finished rounds can be shared as replays or exported as video, and an audience mode lets stream viewers vote with a code. No account is needed to play. The interface is available in six languages.
